name: warden
description: Six PreToolUse guards. On the Bash tool, four deny outright: printing a secret-shaped environment variable, reading a secret-shaped path, editing a file in place with a stream editor, and waiting on sleep. A fifth asks before curl sends a body or a file to a host outside loopback. On the Agent tool, the sixth denies a spawn that names no model, unless it is a fork or its agent definition pins one.
